Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

This past week has been one for the books — a true whirlwind of global adventure, groundbreaking innovation, and deep, overflowing gratitude. Sitting here reflecting, I’m feeling profoundly blessed by every mile, every connection, and every moment captured.

It kicked off across the Atlantic with Tesla Takeover Europe in Austria. What an incredible, high-energy gathering! Massive thanks to the outstanding @TeslaClubAT team for putting together such a seamless and inspiring event. We linked up with passionate owners from across the continent, toured the impressive Giga Berlin (witnessing world-class manufacturing in action), wandered the beautiful streets of Prague, and even had some wild fun — including a Cybertruck scuba adventure in Austria.
One of the absolute highlights was spending several full days traveling all over Europe with the GOAT himself, Sandy Munro. The stories, the wisdom, the laughs — I soaked up every minute and learned more than I can put into words. Grateful too for the chance to borrow a fantastic Tesla and experience the continent the sustainable way. Europe delivered in every sense. The global Tesla community continues to amaze me: families, dreamers, innovators, and forward-thinkers from every background, all united by a shared vision for sustainable energy and autonomy. No other brand creates this kind of connection.
From the charm of Europe, I transitioned straight into the heart of American innovation in Texas. At Giga Texas, I took to the skies with the drone to capture the sheer scale of this production powerhouse from above — those aerial perspectives never get old. Then came a true privilege: an exclusive behind-the-scenes walk-through and tour of The Boring Company’s production line. I was honored to be the first to film it, and seeing those massive tunneling machines and the engineering vision up close was genuinely awe-inspiring. This is infrastructure that will literally help reshape how cities move and grow in the future.
Capping off the week, I got to witness Tesla’s unsupervised rides in action — vehicles navigating real roads fully autonomously, no human supervision required. Watching the FSD visualization light up while the car handled everything flawlessly was a powerful reminder of how close we are to safer, more accessible mobility for everyone. These aren’t just tech demos anymore; they’re glimpses of the future unfolding in real time.
Looking back across the week, what stands out most is the incredible pace of progress and how interconnected this mission really is — from the electric community energy in Europe and Giga Berlin, to the relentless manufacturing and tunneling innovation in Texas, to the autonomy that promises to change lives. It’s humbling to play even a small role in documenting and sharing these stories with the TOSV community and beyond.
Above all, I feel deeply blessed. Blessed by these open doors and the trust to capture moments like the first-ever footage inside the Boring Company production line. Blessed by the incredible people — organizers, engineers, fellow owners, and legends like Sandy Munro — who make it all possible. Blessed with the strength and provision to travel, create, and show up fully, even while navigating challenges at home. And most of all, thankful to God for His grace, protection across continents, and the purpose woven through every opportunity.
To the Tesla Owners Austria team, the Boring Company crew for the access, Sandy Munro, the Tesla teams, and our amazing global community — thank you. Your passion and support fuel everything I do.
What a week. What a mission. What a blessing. ⚡️🙏
More footage and stories coming soon — stay tuned
